citation: Goedel WC, Shapiro A, Cerda M, et al. Association of racial/ethnic segregation with treatment capacity for opioid use disorder in counties in the United States. JAMA Netw Open. 2020;3(4):e203711
data_sources: SAMHSA facility databases (methadone = licensed OTPs; buprenorphine = facilities with waivered prescribers); American Community Survey
access_or_exposure_measure: Facilities per 100000 population; two county segregation measures (including dissimilarity)
